What is AstraMate?

AstraMate is a mobile perception unit — a spherical drone with integrated internal rotors — designed to be the eyes, ears, and security layer for humanoid robots in real-world environments. Before a robot enters any space, AstraMate evaluates it.

Design Philosophy

A sphere has no aggressive front. It evokes protection, mobility, balance and fluidity. With protected internal rotors, the AstraMate drone is designed to be safe around people, objects and sensitive spaces. Not an intimidating machine — an elegant, familiar technological presence.
